name: Proterguride
summary: Proterguride, also known as 6-propylterguride or 6-propyl-9,10-dihydrolisuride, is a dopamine agonist of the ergoline family described as a prolactin inhibitor and antiparkinsonian agent which was never marketed. It is closely structurally related to certain other ergolines like terguride and lisuride. Besides dopamine receptors, the drug also interacts with serotonin, adrenergic, and histamine receptors.

pharmacology.text: Proterguride (INN; developmental code names VUFB-13416, ZK-39437), also known as 6-propylterguride or 6-propyl-9,10-dihydrolisuride, is a dopamine agonist of the ergoline family described as a prolactin inhibitor and antiparkinsonian agent which was never marketed.
pharmacology.kind: Dopamine agonist; Prolactin inhibitor; Antiparkinsonian agent

uses.text: Proterguride (INN; developmental code names VUFB-13416, ZK-39437), also known as 6-propylterguride or 6-propyl-9,10-dihydrolisuride, is a dopamine agonist of the ergoline family described as a prolactin inhibitor and antiparkinsonian agent which was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people, as it was never marketed. Dopamine agonists as a group can cause nausea, dizziness, low blood pressure, sleepiness, hallucinations and impulse control problems.
sideEffects.zh: 由於從未上市，人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。多巴胺促效劑整體而言可能引起噁心、頭暈、血壓偏低、嗜睡、幻覺和衝動控制問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 由于从未上市，人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。多巴胺促效剂整体而言可能引起恶心、头晕、血压偏低、嗜睡、幻觉和冲动控制问题。

fact.en: Proterguride is a relative of lisuride, which is itself a close chemical cousin of LSD that does not usually cause hallucinations.
fact.zh: Proterguride 是麥角乙脲的近親，而麥角乙脲本身是 LSD 的化學近親，但通常不會引起幻覺。
fact.zhHans: Proterguride 是麦角乙脲的近亲，而麦角乙脲本身是 LSD 的化学近亲，但通常不会引起幻觉。
